name: Camp Walnut
description_short: Four week musical theatre camp at Walnut Street Theatre in Center City for ages 8 to 18, Monday to Thursday. Beginners in the Discovery Division write and stage an original musical with no audition; auditioned Development and Performance students rehearse a junior or youth edition musical, all ending in public performances at the theatre.
special_needs_notes: The theatre says it welcomes students of all abilities, including those with disabilities and children who are developmentally typical.

sessions.name: Discovery 1: Little Red Riding Hood, an original musical (ages 8 to 11, no audition)
Discovery 2: The Wizard of Oz, an original musical (ages 12 to 18, no audition)
Development 1: Aladdin KIDS (ages 8 to 11, by audition)
Development 2: The Little Mermaid KIDS (ages 12 to 17, by audition)
Musical Theatre 1: Once Upon A Mattress Youth Edition (ages 10 to 18, by audition)
Musical Theatre 2: Something Rotten JR. (ages 10 to 18, by audition)

notes: All programs run July 12 to August 5, 2027, Monday to Thursday (Discovery 9:30 to 3:30, Development 9:30 to 4:00, Performance 9:30 to 4:30). Public performances: Discovery and Development on August 7, Performance Division August 5 to 8. Development and Performance auditions the week of May 17 to 20. Drop off from 8:45; aftercare to 5:30 is $25 a day. One price for everyone.
